{
  "dataset_name": "credit_g",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "checking_status_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal encoding of checking account status from worst to best financial standing, normalized to [0,1]",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "account_status",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear projection of checking account health directly separates creditworthy applicants along a smooth continuous axis",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(checking_status == '<0', 0.0, np.where(checking_status == '0<=X<200', 0.33, np.where(checking_status == '>=200', 0.67, 1.0)))"
    },
    {
      "name": "savings_status_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal encoding of savings account status from lowest to highest savings, normalized to [0,1]",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "account_status",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Continuous savings level score enables linear margin separation based on financial cushion",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(savings_status == '<100', 0.0, np.where(savings_status == '100<=X<500', 0.25, np.where(savings_status == '500<=X<1000', 0.5, np.where(savings_status == '>=1000', 0.75, 1.0))))"
    },
    {
      "name": "employment_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal encoding of employment duration from unemployed to long-term employed, normalized to [0,1]",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "employment_stability",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth employment stability score supports linear decision boundaries for creditworthiness",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(employment == 'unemployed', 0.0, np.where(employment == '<1', 0.25, np.where(employment == '1<=X<4', 0.5, np.where(employment == '4<=X<7', 0.75, 1.0))))"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_credit_amount_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed credit amount normalized by training mean and std to reduce skewness for linear models",
      "value_range": [-2.5, 3.5],
      "feature_family": "credit_burden",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Log normalization reduces heavy tail of credit amounts, improving linear SVM margin quality",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.log1p(credit_amount) - np.log1p(3778.04)) / (np.log1p(3778.04 + 3166.38) - np.log1p(3778.04))"
    },
    {
      "name": "duration_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Credit duration normalized to [0,1] using training min/max range",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "credit_burden",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalized duration provides smooth continuous feature for linear margin on loan term risk",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((duration - 4.0) / (60.0 - 4.0), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "credit_burden_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of log credit amount to duration capturing monthly repayment intensity, normalized by typical values",
      "value_range": [0.05, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "credit_burden",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Composite ratio captures repayment intensity as a single linear feature, useful for SVM hyperplane",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(credit_amount) / np.maximum(duration, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "financial_stability_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted composite of checking status score, savings score, and employment score representing overall financial stability",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "financial_health",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Single composite score approximates a linear projection of financial health dimensions for SVM margin",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(0.4 * np.where(checking_status == '<0', 0.0, np.where(checking_status == '0<=X<200', 0.33, np.where(checking_status == '>=200', 0.67, 1.0))) + 0.35 * np.where(savings_status == '<100', 0.0, np.where(savings_status == '100<=X<500', 0.25, np.where(savings_status == '500<=X<1000', 0.5, np.where(savings_status == '>=1000', 0.75, 1.0)))) + 0.25 * np.where(employment == 'unemployed', 0.0, np.where(employment == '<1', 0.25, np.where(employment == '1<=X<4', 0.5, np.where(employment == '4<=X<7', 0.75, 1.0)))), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Age normalized to [0,1] using training min/max, capturing maturity and financial experience",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "demographic",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalized age provides smooth continuous feature for linear separation based on borrower maturity",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((age - 20.0) / (68.0 - 20.0), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "installment_to_credits_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of installment commitment rate to existing credits, measuring per-credit payment burden",
      "value_range": [0.25, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "credit_burden",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures debt service intensity per existing credit line as a smooth ratio for linear models",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "installment_commitment / np.maximum(existing_credits, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "property_collateral_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal score of property magnitude as collateral quality from no property to real estate",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "collateral",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Continuous collateral quality score enables linear margin based on asset backing of the loan",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(property_magnitude == 'no known property', 0.0, np.where(property_magnitude == 'life insurance', 0.33, np.where(property_magnitude == 'car', 0.67, 1.0)))"
    },
    {
      "name": "credit_history_risk_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic risk score for credit history quality: 0=critical/other existing (highest risk), 0.25=delayed previously, 0.5=no credits/all paid (neutral), 0.75=all paid (good), 1.0=existing paid (best). Reflects repayment reliability signal.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "credit_history",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Semantically ordered credit history score provides interpretable linear feature capturing repayment track record",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "purpose_risk_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic risk score for loan purpose: productive/stable purposes (used car=0.8, business=0.6, education=0.7) score higher than consumption (new car=0.4, radio/tv=0.5, furniture=0.5) with repairs/domestic lowest (0.2-0.3). Range 0.2 to 0.9.",
      "value_range": [0.2, 0.9],
      "feature_family": "loan_purpose",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Purpose-based risk ordering provides a smooth semantic feature capturing loan use quality for linear SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
